historicalIPhoneOSVsAndroid.scope: Two-pin historical comparison; same 15 byte-identical Apple app Swift inputs, old device compile retained. This lane built only the Simulator slice at the new pin.

corrections.link-observation: Separated the native source preimage file from the command receipt, hashed raw link maps and followed the app link map through the two Swift package partial link maps.
corrections.mixer-export: The initial staging regex assumed a minimum version. Corrected for the pinned SDK's exact dependency version and verified both path-only substitutions against pinned blobs.
corrections.ota-readback-first: The deliberate signature mutation reached expected refusal, but the test matched the unprefixed error code. The corrected readback passed on the same delivered signatures. The host diagnostic was matched by program UUID and PID and removed.

custody.compilerCustodyCoverage: Xcode completed SwiftCompile and Ld tasks, and all build parents were reaped with ESRCH on the exact owned process groups. The terminal process table had no compiler or build command with this scratch namespace. Individual Xcode compiler PIDs were not collected. Shared Xcode services were not controlled.

ios.osSigning: Xcode CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO. Linker-generated arm64 ad hoc executable code directory verified on a standalone copy. The app has no OS resource seal, team identity, app entitlements or provisioning profile. Strict app bundle verification reports an absent resource seal.

signing.binaryBinding: The signed manifest and assignment point to the runtime fingerprint, derived from the identity which hashes the exact link-input preimage. The preimage includes the final unchanged executable, Info.plist, compiler configuration, candidate source/VM rosters, compiled VM archive and guest. Generated release JSON and OTA-root bytes are not part of the link preimage. The identity binds the root bytes separately.
signing.implementation: Replay Sign.swift from the public pin with metadata plumbing for observed target/provenance and an explicit SDK native-capability match.
signing.installedReadback: Separate macOS process read the delivered bundle. Public InstalledCapabilityExecution admitted the material and observed native fingerprint. ReleaseVerifierV3 verified both signed documents and refused separate artifact-signature, assignment-signature and guest-byte mutations. No application storage operation or guest execution was invoked.
signing.rootMaterial: Ephemeral in-process Ed25519 private key; only its scoped public root is emitted.
